evidence_role: Retrospective mechanism diagnostic on already exposed bilingual development data; not confirmation and not a new method comparison.
question: Does aggregate two-language Gini understate sentence-aligned imbalance through cancellation of opposite signed token gaps, making it a misaligned selection objective for cross-domain transfer?

mathematics.cancellation_ratio: 1-abs(sum_i(a_i-b_i))/sum_i(abs(a_i-b_i)); defined as 0 only when every gap is zero
mathematics.structural_note: Aggregate equality can be zero while sentence imbalance is positive because signed gaps cancel; varying denominators mean aggregate Gini and mean sentence Gini have no general equality or ordering.

inputs.books: The identical 10 exposed OPUS Books works with 512 aligned English-French rows each.
inputs.development: Exposed TICO dev100 paired token costs; the file historically named tico.confirm remains exposed and is excluded from method-selection conclusions.
inputs.arms: Nine original arms plus pair_minmax/pair_pooled, full_minmax/full_pooled, eff_minmax/eff_pooled/exact_train: 16 total.

retrospective_predictions: full_minmax has zero aggregate Gini on TICO dev100 but nonzero sentence Gini and near-complete signed-gap cancellation.
The percentage reduction from Classical will be materially larger for aggregate Gini than for sentence Gini, exposing an objective-to-estimand gap.

Across the 16 arms, rankings by exposed TICO aggregate Gini and Books sentence-level fairness will disagree; descriptive Spearman magnitude below 0.3 is called weak, 0.3 to 0.6 moderate, and above 0.6 strong, without inferential significance wording.

A method is not treated as a promising sentence-aware successor unless it improves Books mean sentence Gini or mean absolute gap versus Classical without increasing mean total token cost; all such observations remain development-only.

analysis.primary_units: Paired sentences for within-dataset metrics; Books works for macro comparisons and direction counts.
outputs: Per-arm TICO dev100 aggregate Gini, sentence Gini, mean absolute gap, cancellation ratio, signed-gap counts and cost.
Per-arm Books micro and work-macro versions of the same metrics.
Exact recomputation checks against stored Gini/mean_sentence_gini values.
Spearman rank correlations and rank differences across arms.
Deterministic contrasts with Classical and the three recent minmax-family arms.
analysis.uncertainty: No p-values or population confidence claims. The 16 arms are correlated design variants, and 10 works are not author-independent.
analysis.decision_rule: If mismatch is observed, freeze no candidate yet: derive whether a sentence-level objective can be updated exactly and cost-constrained on the current CPU budget. If aggregate and sentence rankings agree strongly and recent arms improve both, reject this mechanism and investigate domain/source shift instead.
